rationale: The promise diagnostics showed that the StopSign holders and node 3 all ended at accepted 37, so the last open point is whether node 3's position 37 is the StopSign or whether the decision at 38 refers to a later position that node 3 never accepted. is_reconfigured() answers that directly: a node whose log ends in an accepted StopSign reports Some, and one whose log ends in a normal entry reports None. This revision keeps the seeded run, the node 3 trace, the promise diagnostics and the comparison unchanged and adds encoded is_reconfigured values for nodes 3 and 4 to the safety event.

experiment.revision_reason: Adds n3_reconfig and n4_reconfig to the safety event, encoding is_reconfigured() as 0 for None, 1 for Some(false) and 2 for Some(true). The seeded schedule, node 3 trace, promise diagnostics, fields and comparison are unchanged.

scope.description: Same five-node lossy stress with seed 0xbe5466cf34e90c6c, reconfigure at action 450, 20 percent loss, node 3 ordered trace and node 4 promise diagnostics, run id 13. The safety event additionally encodes is_reconfigured() for nodes 3 and 4 as 0 for None, 1 for Some(false) and 2 for Some(true).
assumptions: is_reconfigured() returns Some exactly when the node's log holds an accepted StopSign, with the bool reporting whether it is decided.
The reconfiguration is proposed only once, so at most one StopSign exists in the log.
No snapshots, trimming or next configuration are involved.
excluded: Starting the next configuration, snapshots, flexible quorums, crash-restart and Byzantine participants.

experiment.prefix: Identical to randomized_reconfig_diagnose_lag with the node 3 ordered trace and the node 4 promise diagnostics, including the seeded 900-action schedule, the reconfigure at action 450 and the 150-round convergence loop. The safety event gains n3_reconfig and n4_reconfig, computed as nodes[2].is_reconfigured() and nodes[3].is_reconfigured() mapped to 0 for None, 1 for Some(false) and 2 for Some(true).

comparisons.description: Bounded convergence past the resend timeout: all nodes report the same decided index.
